crop.selectionHelp: Arrow keys move the area (10× with Shift); {alt}+arrow keys resize it.
crop.error.ratio: With this ratio the maximum is {max} px.
bg.note.ratio: To match the ratio, the padding on one side is wider than the setting.
bg.note.shadow: The padding was widened so the shadow isn't cut off.
bg.note.corners: The corner radius is applied as {radius} px to fit the image.
bg.note.reduced: Padding and shadow didn't fit within the maximum size, so the padding was reduced to {padding} px.
bg.note.maxEdge: The longest side is at most {maxEdge} px (change it in Settings). The image is never enlarged.
bg.jpegNote: JPEG can't store transparency, so the background is saved opaque.
compress.pngHint: For PNG the size is controlled by the mode instead of quality.
compress.someNotSmaller.one: {count} file won't get smaller than its original. You may want to keep that original.
compress.someNotSmaller.other: {count} files won't get smaller than their originals. You may want to keep those originals.
compress.batchSmaller: Expected to be {percent}% smaller in total.
compress.batchNotSmaller: In total the results won't be smaller than the originals. Change the settings or keep the originals.
compress.notSmaller: It won't be smaller than the original. Change the settings or keep the original.
compress.resultNotSmaller: The result isn't smaller than the original (+{percent}%). You may want to keep the original.
meta.gpsWarning: This image contains location (GPS) data. Consider removing it before sharing.
meta.icc.convert: Convert to sRGB and remove the profile (recommended)
meta.stripInfo: Creates a new copy without EXIF, XMP, IPTC and thumbnails. The photo's orientation is applied to the pixels, so it looks the same. The original isn't changed.
annotate.help: Pick a tool, then drag on the image. For text, click where it should go. Enter confirms, Shift+Enter adds a line.
annotate.added.arrow: Arrow added in the centre. Move it with the arrow keys; {alt}+arrow keys move its tip.
annotate.added.rect: Rectangle added in the centre. Move it with the arrow keys; {alt}+arrow keys resize it.
annotate.keysHelp: Keyboard: insert with the Add buttons, move with the arrow keys (Shift ×10), resize with {alt}+arrow keys, Delete removes, Enter edits text.
annotate.unsaved: Your annotations haven't been saved yet. They'll be lost if you close.
annotate.fontUnreadable.one: {count} text annotation can't be drawn at all with the installed fonts and won't be visible in the result.
annotate.fontUnreadable.other: {count} text annotations can't be drawn at all with the installed fonts and won't be visible in the result.
redact.help: Drag over the areas you want to hide.
redact.mosaicNote: Mosaic isn't guaranteed to remove the information. Use a solid box for sensitive content.
redact.empty: Mark at least one area to hide.
redact.metadataNote: Redactions are burned into the final pixels, and the result keeps no original thumbnail or metadata.
redact.added: Area added in the centre. Move it with the arrow keys; {alt}+arrow keys resize it.
redact.keysHelp: Keyboard: insert with Add area, move with the arrow keys (Shift ×10), resize with {alt}+arrow keys, Delete removes.
redact.unsaved: The areas you marked haven't been saved yet. They'll be lost if you close.
pdf.help: Drag or use the arrow buttons to change the order. Each image becomes one page.
pdf.keysHelp: {alt}+Up/Down arrows reorder the pages; Up/Down arrows move between rows.

jobs.emptyHint: Drag a file in Finder while holding {convert} (Convert) or {tools} (Tools), or drop a file on the Drop Zone.
jobs.retryUnavailable: Can't retry: the original file is missing, or the job ran before OrbitDrop restarted. Open the file again.
jobs.clearFinishedHint: Removes completed, failed and cancelled jobs from the list and history. Result files stay where they are.
jobs.emptyHintPc: Drag a file in File Explorer while holding {convert} (Convert) or {tools} (Tools), or drop a file on the Drop Zone.
settings.title: Settings
settings.notifications: Notify me when a job started by dragging finishes
update.title: Updates
update.state.idleAutoOff: Automatic checks are off. Use “Check Now” to check.
update.state.downloaded: Version {version} is ready. It installs when you quit OrbitDrop.
update.state.restartPending: OrbitDrop restarts to update as soon as your work is done.
update.error.offline: Couldn’t check for updates: this computer is offline.
update.error.network: Couldn’t check for updates: GitHub could not be reached.
update.error.failed: The update couldn’t be checked or installed.
update.unsupported.smokeTest: Updates aren’t checked during the self test.
update.unsupported.notSigned: This unsigned test build doesn’t update automatically. Get new versions from the releases page.
update.unsupported.unknownBuild: This build can’t be identified, so it doesn’t update automatically. Get new versions from the releases page.
update.unsupported.readOnlyLocation: OrbitDrop is running from a disk image or another read-only location, so updates can’t be installed. Move it to the Applications folder and open it from there.
update.unsupported.notInstalled: Only copies installed with the OrbitDrop installer update automatically. Get new versions from the releases page.
update.unsupported.noUpdateConfig: This build has no update configuration. Get new versions from the releases page.
update.unsupported.platform: Automatic updates aren’t available on this operating system.
update.settings.privacy: Checking sends GitHub only standard connection details such as your IP address and a request for this system’s update file — no device ID, files or usage data.
settings.notice.settingsReset: The settings file could not be read, so the defaults apply. The old file was kept in the app data folder as {file}.
settings.notice.settingsReset.noBackup: The settings file could not be read, so the defaults apply.
settings.notice.historyReset: The job history file could not be read, so the history started empty. The old file was kept in the app data folder as {file}.
settings.notice.historyReset.noBackup: The job history file could not be read, so the history started empty.
settings.notice.translated: The Intel (x64) build of OrbitDrop is running under Rosetta 2. This Mac needs the Apple silicon (arm64) build — it starts faster, and macOS is ending support for Intel apps.
settings.globalDrag: Open the wheel with a modifier key while dragging a file
settings.keysHint: Hold these keys while dragging to open the wheel.
settings.keysMacNote: On macOS, Control and Command can't be used: holding them turns the drag into a link instead of a copy, so the wheel can't accept the drop.
settings.keysWinNote: On Windows, Alt+Shift also switches the input language and releasing the Windows key opens Start. A combination that doesn't overlap is recommended.
settings.keys.warn.altShift: Alt+Shift overlaps the input-language switch: the input language may change while you drag.
settings.keys.warn.winKey: Releasing the Windows key may open Start.
settings.keys.error.same: The Convert and Tools menus need different key combinations.
settings.keys.error.macUnsupported: Control and Command don't work on macOS. Choose other keys.
settings.wheelPreviewCaption: Shown at {percent}% of actual size · dashed rings mark the smallest and largest size
settings.helper.noGlobalDrag: The helper is running, but global drag isn't available: {reason}
settings.helper.permissionSteps: Allow OrbitDrop in System Settings › Privacy & Security, then restart the app.
settings.helper.fallback: Meanwhile, the Drop Zone and Open Files offer the same features.
settings.inputMonitoring.note: Without Input Monitoring, Esc closes the wheel only while the pointer is over it. To close it with Esc anywhere, allow OrbitDrop in System Settings.
settings.numberError: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
about.title: About OrbitDrop
about.tagline: Drag a file and pick from the ring. Everything is processed on this computer.
welcome.title: Get Started with OrbitDrop
welcome.heading: Welcome to OrbitDrop
welcome.lead: Hold a key while you drag a file and a ring menu opens next to the pointer. Drop the file on a format or tool: the result is saved next to the original, which stays as it is.
welcome.how.title: How to use it
welcome.how.dragMac: Start dragging a file in Finder.
welcome.how.dragPc: Start dragging a file in File Explorer.
welcome.how.keys: While dragging, hold the keys and a wheel opens.
welcome.how.convert: Convert wheel: to another format such as JPG, PNG or PDF
welcome.how.tools: Tools wheel: edits such as Crop, Add Background or Compress
welcome.how.drop: Drop the file on an item of the wheel. The result appears next to the original.
welcome.how.keysNote: You can change the keys in Settings › Drag.
welcome.how.disabled: Global drag is off right now. Turn it on in Settings › Drag, or use the Drop Zone below.
welcome.where.title: Where is OrbitDrop?
welcome.where.mac: It runs without a window in the menu bar (top right of the screen) and doesn't appear in the Dock. Its menu bar icon has Open File, the Drop Zone, Settings and Help.
welcome.where.win: It runs without a window in the notification area at the right of the taskbar. Click its icon for Open File, the Drop Zone, Settings and Help.
welcome.where.winOverflow: Windows 11 may hide new icons under ^ (Show hidden icons). Find the OrbitDrop icon there and drag it onto the taskbar to keep it visible.
welcome.fallback: If dragging is awkward, drop files on the Drop Zone or pick them with Open File… in the menu.
welcome.launchAtLoginHint: When on, OrbitDrop starts automatically when you log in. You can change this any time in Settings › General.
welcome.privacy: Everything is processed on this computer. No account is needed and no usage data is sent.
diag.title: Troubleshooting
diag.hint: Copies the version, OS, drag helper state, an engine summary and recent log lines with paths hidden to the clipboard. Paste it into a problem report.
diag.copied.one: Diagnostics copied (with {count} recent log line, paths hidden).
diag.copied.other: Diagnostics copied (with {count} recent log lines, paths hidden).
about.legal.privacyLocal: Your files never leave this computer. There is no account and no telemetry.
about.legal.privacyUpdates: The update check (on by default) looks for a new version on GitHub. GitHub sees standard connection details such as your IP address and which update file is requested — no files, usage data or device ID. Turn it off in Settings › General.
about.legal.privacyCrashes: Crash reports are stored on this computer only and are never sent anywhere.
about.legal.privacyHistory: The job history (history.json) keeps recent file names on this computer only; Clear Finished in the Jobs window removes them.
crash.recovered: This window stopped unexpectedly and was reopened.
crash.recoveredEditor: The edit settings you were choosing are back to their defaults. Your original file wasn't changed.
crash.unsavedLost: Unsaved annotations or redaction areas were lost.
crash.failed.title: This window can't be reopened
crash.failed.body: The window stopped again, so its content isn't shown. Close the window and open it again. Your original files weren't changed.
crash.view.title: Something went wrong in this window
crash.view.body: An error occurred while drawing this window. Close it and open it again. Your original files weren't changed.
crash.editorLost: Unsaved work in this editor was lost.
crash.report: If this keeps happening, please use Help › Report a Problem. Details were written to the log folder.
data.title: Data
data.folderHint: The folder with your settings, job history and logs. It stays when OrbitDrop is removed.
data.resetHint: Puts every setting back to this computer's defaults. The language, job history and output files stay.
data.resetConfirm.title: Reset settings?
data.resetConfirm.message: Conversion and saving, drag keys, processing, accessibility and notification settings and “Open OrbitDrop at login” go back to their defaults. The language and job history stay.
data.resetDone: Settings are back to their defaults.
help.keysHint.dropzone: Hold {convert} while dragging a file in Finder to open the wheel without this window.
help.keysHint.dropzonePc: Hold {convert} while dragging a file in File Explorer to open the wheel without this window.
